implementation.name: original-v2-federated-averaging-cycle
implementation.scope: The original coordinator and five-client round. Declared toy scalar models θk = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 and example counts nk = 1, 2, 1, 2, 3 illustrate the weighting rule; these are not measurements.
implementation.question: Whose model enters this FedAvg round?

purpose: Whose model enters this FedAvg round?
storyboard: The coordinator selects all five illustrated clients and broadcasts the same initial model θ = 0. Private data stays on each client.
Clients train on their own data. Four clients finish within this illustrated round; client 5 is still running. Local completion times are schematic.
Clients 1–4 upload their completed models before the deadline. The accepted models and their example counts are held by the coordinator.
The deadline passes. Client 5 is excluded from this round, so its three examples do not enter the aggregation denominator.
The coordinator multiplies each accepted model by its accepted example count, sums these contributions, and divides by the accepted example total. The result becomes the next global model.
guard: Only clients 1–4 are timely and accepted. Normalize by their sample counts only. No assertion that all invited clients contribute or that model averaging is an unweighted mean.
